acquisition_method.evidence: About 1 μg of peptide digests were separated on a 50 cm C18 column using 2.5 h gradient elution and analyzed in a DDA mode on the Orbitrap Exploris 480 (Thermo Fisher Scientific) mass spectrometer.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Briefly, cellular pellets (100 μg of protein) were processed according to the protocol for in-solution trypsin digestion.

labeling.evidence: inferred: Label-free quantification mass spectrometry analysis (LFQ-MS) of cell pellets was performed in technical triplicates.
